doc.title: Fastening-feature census, from the measured interface records

note: Every row is a feature a part MEASURED off its own geometry and recorded. The census classifies and counts them; it measures nothing new and upgrades no part's own CANNOT DETERMINE. The implied fastener comes from the ISO clearance and tap-drill tables in cecad/fasteners.py, never from a guess.
open_question: SPEC.md:75-76 reads the whole robot as a 145-hole M2 system (77 clearance, 28 counterbore, 20 tap, 20 larger) from a community hole analysis. This census reads only what our part folders have recorded so far. The difference between the two counts is the measurement still to do, and it is stated rather than reconciled away.

rows.name: roll_bearing_face
rows.why: the record states its mate is CANNOT DETERMINE
rows.measured: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01/02: meshfeatures.cylinders hole Ø19 axis y centre (17.5, -14, 0); spec/mesh-placements.json seeed_bearing 22x16x4 origin (17.5, -18.5, 0) with +z -> +y in this frame; bearing mesh meshslice.intervals inner race r 8..9, outer r 10..11, z 0..4; xl330 bosses Ø16 x 3 at ±14.5 on its axis; hip_l.stl boss Ø16 len 1.95 at y -17.525, holes Ø2.4 at (17.5±6, -18.0, 0) (17.5, -18.0, ±6)
rows.what: The back face (y -14.5) around the Ø19.0 window on the roll axis. The MJCF puts the 22x16x4 hip-roll bearing at mesh (17.5, -18.5, 0) with its axis along +y and the bearing mesh spanning 0..4 along that axis, so its near face IS this face (y -14.5). The window clears the inner race (OD 18.0) by 0.5 mm radially and lets the XL330 horn's Ø16 x 3 boss (y -16.5..-13.5) pass through into the bearing bore; the plate bears axially on the outer race (Ø20..22) and on nothing else. hip_l's Ø16 x 1.95 boss (y -18.5..-16.55) fills the other half of the bore and bolts to the horn face at y -16.5 with 4 x Ø2.4 on r 6. Not a radial seat: which part seats the outer race radially is CANNOT DETERMINE (hip_l.stl shows no Ø22 bore) — a physical unit settles it.
